## What happened?

Describe the observed and expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide the shortest reproducible steps and synthetic inputs. Include the
application version, Node.js version, OS, and browser if relevant. Include the
Python version when reporting a local preview or repository-tooling problem.

## Impact

Which workflow or technique is affected? Include an ATT&CK ID when applicable.

## Evidence

Attach redacted output or a screenshot without credentials or private logs.
For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md rather than posting details here.
